title: A Noetherian irreducible component contains a nonempty open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is Noetherian (every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes), and let $Z\subseteq |X|$ be an irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components]. Then there is a nonempty open subset $O\subseteq |X|$ with $O\subseteq Z$.
